trust.title: Why Schoolera?
trust.subtitle: We give you the tools and information you need to choose the right learning environment for your child with confidence.
trust.item1Body: Find schools by location, educational stage, curriculum, and more.
trust.item2Body: Compare your options using the available school and educational information.
trust.item3Body: Review clear and organized information that supports better decisions.
trust.item4Body: Find the available contact options for each school with ease.

parents.title: Benefits for parents
parents.subtitle: We support every step of your journey toward choosing a school that fits your family's goals and your child's needs.
parents.imageAlt: A family exploring school options together on the platform
parents.benefit1Body: Start from an organized list instead of scattered searching across many sources.
parents.benefit2Body: Rely on clear information before you take your next step.
parents.benefit3Body: Choose the learning environment that fits your child's ambitions and needs.

schools.title: Benefits for educational institutions
schools.subtitle: Clearer digital presence for families who are actively searching.
schools.card1Body: Present your school in a public list that parents can reach easily.
schools.card2Body: Richer school profiles, fees, and branches will be built in later stages.
schools.card3Body: Receive family interest when communication and admission channels become available.

journey.title: How Schoolera works
journey.subtitle: Choose your path: parent or educational institution.
journey.parentStep1Body: Open the schools list and browse currently available options.
journey.parentStep2Body: Check the essential information available for each school.
journey.parentStep3Body: Prepare your account so you are ready for the next steps.
journey.parentStep4Body: Admission and follow-up journeys will be connected when they are ready.
journey.schoolStep1Body: Start by choosing the educational-institution account type.
journey.schoolStep2Body: Enter the essential details so families can find your school.
journey.schoolStep3Body: Richer profiles with media, fees, and stages will be added later.
journey.schoolStep4Body: Managing interest and admissions will arrive in later stages.

highlights.title: What we offer clearly today
highlights.subtitle: No invented metrics or unreliable statistics.
highlights.item1Body: A schools list is available on the platform now.
highlights.item2Body: A complete experience in both directions with instant language switching.
highlights.item3Body: From search to account creation, then upcoming capabilities.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Short answers that explain the platform today.
faq.q1: Can I search for a school now?
faq.a1: Yes. The school search page is available and shows currently registered schools.
faq.q2: Are comparison, applications, and payments ready?
faq.a2: Not yet. Advanced comparison, admission journeys, contracts, and payments will be built in later stages.
faq.q3: Does the platform support Arabic and English?
faq.a3: Yes. Arabic is the default, with full English support and direction switching.
faq.q4: How can a school join Schoolera?
faq.a4: Start by creating an educational-institution account. Detailed onboarding will expand later.
faq.a5: No. Schoolera is an independent platform connecting families and schools and does not claim government affiliation.
